target.definition: v ~ Normal(0,3); x_i | v ~ Normal(0,exp(v/2)), i=1..9

hypotheses.primary: Initial-step search plus 8000-transition windowed warmup stabilizes final macro-step and mass adaptation across dispersed starts, increasing scale ESS per target call and reducing between-chain scale disagreement.
hypotheses.initialization: The difference between dispersed and common-zero starts estimates finite-warmup initialization sensitivity; common-zero success alone is not sufficient to select the robust adaptation intervention.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject the primary mechanism if robust adaptation fails health, improves median dispersed-start scale bulk ESS per target call by less than 1.5x, has any seed ratio below 0.8x, or remains materially initialization-sensitive.

health_gates_per_cell.note: R-hat/ESS thresholds are short-pilot feasibility gates, not convergence claims.

selection_rule.candidate: robust adaptation policy; initialization is a controlled factor, not a seed-specific choice
required: all robust-policy cells pass every short-pilot health gate for all seeds
paired dispersed-start median scale bulk ESS/target-call ratio robust:baseline >= 1.5
robust common-zero versus dispersed scale bulk ESS/target-call ratio lies in [0.67,1.5] for every seed
robust final qualified step-size max/min across chains <= 4 within every cell
no resource cap failure or missing artifact
selection_rule.credible_confirmation_scaling: For each robust cell, projected 50000-draw scale bulk and tail ESS are 5 times pilot ESS; both projections must be >=400. This projection permits confirmation without requiring confirmation-level ESS in 10000 pilot draws.
selection_rule.outcome: advance one fixed robust policy or no selection; never select an initialization per seed

future_policy.initial_step_search: NumPyro default step-size initialization, disclosed; oWALNUTS-native search has no identical NumPyro control
future_policy.timing: compile excluded; warmup and retained reported separately where APIs permit

resource_policy.budget_exhaustion: fatal; preserve artifact as resource failure and do not select
resource_policy.preflight: compile all 12 seed-by-cell dispatches and require exactly zero target callbacks

excluded_interventions.target_acceptance_095: v1 was inconsistent and sometimes substantially worse than 0.90
excluded_interventions.maximum_error: changing the numerical accuracy criterion would confound mixing with integration tolerance
excluded_interventions.minimum_microsteps: raises work for every leaf without evidence of a scale-mixing mechanism
excluded_interventions.reverse_coarser_rule: a reversibility safeguard; no correctness defect is established
excluded_interventions.maximum_depth: v1 depth-stop rates were already below 0.53%, so trajectory truncation is not the observed bottleneck
excluded_interventions.target_transformation: benchmark-specific parameterization changes are outside this sampler intervention
